title: viburnum hayatae
intro: Viburnum hayatae, commonly known as Japanese snowball viburnum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Adoxaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum hayatae are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective properties.
